notes: All inputs are synthetic and redistributable; no user database was connected or changed.
Reference JSON retains signed 64-bit numeric literals exactly using JSON.rawJSON; consumers must avoid parsing them through IEEE-754 Number.
OpenRefine converts SQL NULL and empty text to null with its default storeBlankCellsAsNulls=true, and to empty strings with the option false.
Duplicate SELECT labels are disambiguated by the PostgreSQL extension but rejected by the wrapped MySQL/MariaDB query used by OpenRefine.
The MySQL/MariaDB extension decodes BLOB data to text and can replace invalid UTF-8; this is observed reference behavior, not a data-preservation recommendation.
